posts.meta_description:
199K likes, 539 comments - palaktiwarii on October 3, 2026: "I had always heard of the famous Rajasthani hospitality but I’ve truly had the pleasure of experiencing it through @brijhotels at their brand new property #brijtararanthambore
Truly one of a kind and incomparable in every sense.
The culturally rooted experiences, the taste of Rajasthan in every scrumptious bite and the kind of music you’d only heard about in lores. I’m in awe. 

Had the honour of dining under ranthambore’s night sky 

Had the best high teas 

When it’s time to leave Rajasthan :(".
